info.name: LogiFlow — Complete API Collection
info.description:
Full API collection for LogiFlow backend. Updated to match current implementation.

## Quick Start
1. Import both files: collection + environment
2. Select **LogiFlow API Environment** from the environment dropdown (top-right)
3. Run **Register (Step 1)** → check email for OTP → run **Verify Email (Step 2)** → tokens auto-saved
4. All subsequent requests automatically use `{{accessToken}}` via the collection-level bearer auth

## Base URL
- Development: `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`
- Production:  `https://logiflow-backend-ai0r.onrender.com/api/v1`

## Authentication
JWT via `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header (or HTTP-only cookie). The collection uses bearer token automatically. Tokens are auto-saved by test scripts on Login and Verify Email.

item.name: 01 — Authentication
item.description:
Registration uses a 2-step OTP flow:
1. POST /register → OTP sent to email (account NOT created yet, stored in Redis for 10 min)
2. POST /verify-email → account created, tokens returned

Rate limits: register & verify-email share 5 req/15 min. Login: 10 req/15 min.

exec: pm.test('No OTP or token exposed in response', () => {

request.description:
Sends a 6-digit OTP to the provided email. Account is NOT created yet.

**Validation rules:**
- `firstName` / `lastName`: 2–50 chars
- `email`: valid email, lowercased
- `password`: 8–64 chars
- `phone`: optional, Bangladesh format (e.g. 01712345678 or +8801712345678)

item.name: Verify Email (Step 2 — creates account, returns tokens)

request.description:
Enter the 6-digit OTP from the email. On success: user created in DB, tokens returned.

**OTP:** exactly 6 digits, expires after 10 minutes. Wrong OTP → 400.

Requires email verification first. Unverified accounts → 401.

**Access token:** 15-minute expiry.
**Refresh token:** 7-day expiry, stored in DB (rotated on refresh).
Issues a new access token + refresh token pair. Old refresh token is revoked immediately (rotation). Reuse of an old token → 401.

Revokes the provided refresh token. Access token remains valid until its 15-minute expiry.

**Auth required:** Yes
